entries.final_answer: Sanitized shape with the per-item mark: schema_version, id (= file stem), description, activated_kinds, activated_<plural> and activated_mission_types lists of {id, must_have?} items; closed schema preset.schema.json.
entries.question: How far does the mission go with presets: round-trip as written, or the sanitized shape with the per-item must-have mark?
entries.rationale: Operator requirement 2026-10-28 (sanitized DSOs) and the #195 ruling (a mark on each item). The as-written shape cannot carry the mark, so #206 would break the same files twice (squad F5). No contract surface carries presets (only @WIP journey prose).
entries.resolved_by: mission author (grounding squad); operator questions on #195

entries.final_answer: By its items: a preset with at least one must_have item governs; the required set is derived from the marks. No preset-level flag.
entries.question: How is a governing preset told from a convenience preset?
entries.rationale: Operator ruling on #195 (a mark on each item; one preset may hold both); one way to say a thing (S6); ADR-0031 decisions 1-2.
entries.resolved_by: mission author (grounding squad); operator questions on #195

entries.final_answer: A preset never had them; the closed preset schema refuses any required_* key. Migrating org-charter.yaml's required_<plural> lists and refusing them there stays in #206.
entries.question: What happens to required_<plural> lists in this mission?

entries.final_answer: Refused by the schema (minItems 1). A kind is switched off only by leaving it out of activated_kinds.
entries.question: How is an empty activation list in a preset treated?
entries.rationale: Core reads [] as 'activate none' and absent as 'unrestricted', while ADR-0036 E2 makes them equal; refusing one spelling keeps both true without a comparator exception (squad F1, rule S6).
entries.resolved_by: mission author (grounding squad); operator questions on #195

entries.final_answer: A pack-level payload of the bytes form (payloads rule */pack.md, kind pack-document); no schema.
entries.question: In what content form is pack.md held?
entries.rationale: No frontmatter and no fields at the pin; bytes is built and the strictest equality; markdown and text stay unbuilt (ADR-0040).
entries.resolved_by: mission author (grounding squad); operator questions on #195

entries.final_answer: Close pack-descriptor.schema.json; remove PackDescriptor.undeclaredKeys and the PACK_UNKNOWN_KEY warning; an unknown key makes pack.yaml unreadable (PACK_UNREADABLE). contracts/charter/** is not edited; the stale pack_unknown_key description is raised on #195.
entries.question: How is pack.yaml made lossless?
entries.rationale: ADR-0036 ruling 1 and decision 3 (accepted); the issue's 'keep the values' is superseded by refusal. No operation references the diagnostic; HTTP contract frozen unless the operator approves (squad F7).
entries.resolved_by: mission author (grounding squad); operator questions on #195

entries.final_answer: The authored-pack variant only: schema_version "1.0", manifest_hash, constituents [{kind, id, path, content_hash}], presets [{id, path, content_hash}]; closed. charter, fetched_at, source_url, source_type, generated_at, generated_by and provenance_path are not in it.
entries.question: What shape does pack-manifest.yaml have?
entries.rationale: Sanitized-shape rules S1-S5; the fetched and charter-bundle variants are not pack content (#110).
entries.resolved_by: mission author (grounding squad); operator questions on #195

entries.final_answer: Recomputed. content_hash and manifest_hash are derived: the writer recomputes them from the bytes it writes (content_hash = SHA-256 of LF-normalised bytes; manifest_hash = SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON without manifest_hash). Membership is carried as read; a listed path missing from the written pack refuses the write. The reader does not check freshness; the gate verifies derived fields on both sides.
entries.question: Is content_hash recomputed on write, or are constituents compared by bytes (ADR-0036 open question 3)?
entries.rationale: Carrying hashes would describe bytes that no longer exist; comparing constituents by bytes contradicts ADR-0036 ruling 2 for YAML (squad F3, F9). JCS is emitter-independent.
entries.resolved_by: mission author (grounding squad); operator questions on #195

entries.final_answer: Every file the round trip covers is a files rule with a closed schema (yaml), a payloads rule of a built non-yaml form, or an exclusion with a reason. A YAML file is never held without a schema. Derived fields are declared per kind in an ADR, never as a reader rule.
entries.question: What is the rule for kinds without a schema (ADR-0036 decision 6)?
entries.rationale: Closes ADR-0036 open question 3 together with the manifest rule.
entries.resolved_by: mission author (grounding squad); operator questions on #195

entries.final_answer: Yes: presets, pack.md and pack-manifest.yaml are appended to PackFileSet.digested after the templates.
entries.question: Does the verified-source fingerprint cover the pack-level files?
entries.rationale: Every file the store reads is in the fingerprint (ADR-0040 decision 9 pattern); #110 stays the contract-scope decision about core's pin.
